function.name: reserve_dryer

function.name: check_machine_status
function.description: Checks whether each of the given laundromat machines is currently free or in use.

machine_ids.description: List of machine numbers as whole numbers (e.g. [3, 12]). Include one entry per machine the customer names.

question: Can you check whether washers 3, 5 and 9 are free right now?

function.name: get_cycle_price
function.description: Returns the current price of a named wash cycle.

cycle_name.description: Name of the wash cycle exactly as it appears on the menu, in lowercase (e.g. 'delicate', 'heavy', 'quick').

function.name: set_detergent_dose

function.name: estimate_drying_time
function.description: Estimates how many minutes a laundry load needs to dry, based on its weight.

load_weight_kg.description: Weight of the dry laundry load in kilograms (kg), decimals allowed (e.g. 4.5).

question: I have 3 kids and 2 dryers at home, but this laundry load is 6.5 kg of towels. How long will it take to dry?

function.name: find_machine

machine_numbers.description: List of machine numbers as whole numbers (e.g. [4, 8]). Include one entry per machine the customer names.

function.name: report_broken_machine
function.description: Files a repair ticket for a malfunctioning machine.

machine_number.description: Machine number printed on the front panel, as a whole number (e.g. 14).

issue_description.description: Short plain-English description of the problem, under 100 characters (e.g. 'door will not latch').

function.name: order_detergent
function.description: Places an order for a detergent product for the laundromat to restock.

product_name.description: Brand and product name exactly as sold (e.g. 'Ultra Clean').

machine_number.description: Machine number printed on the front panel, as a whole number (e.g. 21).

function.name: reserve_telescope_slot
function.description: Reserves a telescope for an observing session on a given date.

telescope_id.description: Telescope identifier, format T-<number>, e.g. T-14

date.description: Observation date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

hours.description: Booking length in whole hours, from 1 to 12

notes.description: Optional free-text note for staff, maximum 200 characters

question: Please reserve telescope T-14 on 2025-03-08 for 3 hours. Our group has five members and we used the 0.8-meter mirror last time.

function.name: reschedule_booking
function.description: Moves an existing observatory booking to a new date and start hour.

booking_id.description: Booking ID, format OBS-<4 digits>, e.g. OBS-0042

new_date.description: New session date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

new_start_hour.description: New start hour on the 24-hour clock, from 0 to 23

question: Booking OBS-2291 was the one I made 14 nights ago and the sky ended up hazy. Can you move it to 2025-06-02 and start at 21 o'clock?

function.name: reserve_ccd_filters
function.description: Adds a list of photometric filters to the CCD configuration of an existing booking.

booking_id.description: Booking ID, format BK-<number>, e.g. BK-508

function.description: Queues a list of observation targets for a session.

session_id.description: Session ID, format S-<number>, e.g. S-77

question: For session S-77, please queue M31, M42 and NGC 224 as the targets.

function.name: get_booking_status

function.name: cancel_booking
function.description: Cancels an observatory booking by its ID.

booking_id.description: Booking ID, format BK-<number>, e.g. BK-1177

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason, free text, maximum 100 characters

question: Cancel booking BK-1177 and refund my deposit in full.

function.name: reserve_instrument
function.description: Reserves a specific instrument for a start time and duration on a date.

instrument_code.description: Instrument code, e.g. REF-12 for the 1.2 m reflector

date.description: Session date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

start_time.description: Start time on the 24-hour clock, format HH:MM

duration_minutes.description: Length of the reservation in minutes, from 15 to 240

function.name: reserve_public_viewing
function.description: Books seats for a public viewing night in one of the observatory domes.

event_date.description: Event date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

visitors.description: Number of visitors to seat, from 1 to 20

dome.description: Dome name, either north or south, lowercase

question: We had 12 people at the open house last spring, which was lovely. Please book 4 seats for the public viewing on 2025-05-17 in the north dome.

function.name: export_observation_log
function.description: Exports the observation log of a session in csv or fits format.

session_id.description: Session ID, format S-<number>, e.g. S-310

format.description: File format, either csv or fits, lowercase

include_weather.description: Whether to append weather readings to the log, true or false

function.description: Books a routine dental cleaning appointment for a patient on a given date.

patient_id.description: Patient chart ID in the format P- followed by exactly five digits, for example P-20417.
